Chapter 580 - Dug Out

Chapter 580 - Dug Out

“Heart blood essence?”

The eyes of the pair of youths lit up, and the handsome male was extremely excited as he seemed to have heard of the legends before; “Apparently the heart blood essence has the ability to transform one anew. If one bathes in it, it increases one’s state of existence and foundation.”

“That’s right.”

The elder who wore a plain shirt nodded his head, “The blood is beneficial even for Sovereigns. If you two are able to bathe in the heart blood essence, I can guarantee that you’ll have a body and a state of being equivalent to a half-step Origin Core Realm, and the chances of breaking through to the Origin Core Realm will be higher.”

Hearing that, the two were extremely excited.

The cultivation of the two were at the early-stage and late-stage of the True Lord Rank. Who knew how long it would take them to break through to the half-step Origin Core Realm, let alone the Origin Core Realm?

It could be said that the heart blood essence of a limitless ocean whale can change one’s potential.

Furthermore, this was a long-term benefit without any downsides, unlike pills or other resources that would leave hidden complications behind.

“Furthermore, the state of existence of this whale is not normal. It’s probably only below that of the legendary limitless ocean whale king.”

The elder in the shirt murmured.

The heart blood essence of this whale would surpass other whales.

“If I use this blood continuously, it’ll push my body and state of existence toward the Void God Realm. Although it won’t increase my chances of breaking through to the Void God Realm per se, at least I’ll have a stronger foundation….”

The elder’s heart thumped.

No one wouldn’t be excited if they had the chance to increase their state of being. Not many people below the Void God Realm would be able to resist the heart blood essence.

“Third Elder, how confident are you in being able to kill this whale?”

The pretty female asked.

“Hehe…. Relax. This limitless ocean whale is extremely weak right now and probably only has 20-30% of its full battle-power remaining. On top of that, its heart is the size of a hall, which is more than enough for you two as well. I can take it back and increase the strength of the clan.”

The elder smiled with confidence. After saying so, he sent a palm thrusting toward the whale.

The environment within dozens of miles changed in front of a Great Origin Core Realm.

Boom~~~~

A dark green palm-light hit the head of the whale.

“Mystic Sky Dark Energy Symbol!”

The figure of a palm condensed in the air and started to become bigger.

Even more incredibly, the Mystic Sky Dark Energy Symbol was slowly sinking into the head of the limitless ocean whale.

Wu~~~

The limitless ocean whale roared and struggled as it revealed a pained expression.

At this moment in time, 80-90% of its organs had been affected by the power of the curse, and it was on its last breath.

“Hahaha…. It’s even weaker than I thought.”

The elder laughed as he dodged a wave that was created from the whale flipping.

At its peak, the whale could create entire tsunamis with a flip and severely injure normal Origin Core Realms.

Within the whale’s body:

“Master, there’s a Great Origin Core Realm Sovereign Lord outside….”

The skeletal Division Leader was worried. They could all feel how strong the Great Origin Core Realm was.

Zhao Feng had used the Void Space Eye Slash to force back Lord Hu Suo, bringing danger upon himself in the process.

From this Great Origin Core Realm’s intent, this one seemed to be even stronger than Lord Hu Suo.

“Hehe, while that Great Origin Core Realm is suppressing the whale, it’s the perfect chance to take the heart blood essence.”

Zhao Feng smiled.

Heart blood essence?

The skeletal Division Leader couldn’t help but be shocked. In this situation where there was danger both inside and outside, Zhao Feng was still thinking about the heart blood essence?

Even if they succeeded, would that Great Origin Core Realm outside give up so easily?

Shua!

The skeletal Division Leader put away the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array and wanted to see how Zhao Feng would achieve his goal.

“We need to break through this realm of acid first.”

Zhao Feng said. It wasn’t too hard to do so at this point since the whale had lost more than half its lifeforce.

“Freeze.”

Zhao Feng circulated his bloodline power and the Ice Imperial Spear as he froze the entire area. The difficulty of doing so was much lower than last time.

“Open a path.”

Zhao Feng gave the next task to the skeletal Division Leader.

Boom Boom Boom~~

The skeletal Division Leader expressionlessly used the phantom of the Nine Deadly Yin Bone and created a tunnel by repeatedly thrusting the weapon.

The process of creating the tunnel was easier than expected, mainly due to the fact that, after the whale lost most of its lifeforce, the acid lost most of its power.

Furthermore, Zhao Feng had used his bloodline power to turn the sticky liquid into a solid, allowing the skeletal Division Leader to create a tunnel easily.

When the two were working, they did their best to conceal their aura in case they alarmed the Great Origin Core Realm outside.

Luckily, the body of the whale was enormous and acted as a barrier, so the disturbance within was covered.

“Let’s go.”

Zhao Feng ordered Loulan Zhishui.

“Understood.”

Loulan Zhishui and company managed the ship and directed it through the tunnel toward the exit.

“Turn left, then right.”

Zhao Feng’s God’s Spiritual Eye had already inspected the structure within the whale’s body.

A while later, the ship was closing in on the heart.

Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!

The sound of the heart thumping brought a huge pressure, and the sailors felt unable to breathe.

If it weren’t for the fact that the whale was extremely weak, Zhao Feng wouldn’t dare to come to its heart while it was alive.

If the whale was at its peak, the thudding from its heart might even cause normal Sovereigns to explode.

The heart of the whale was as big as a small palace, and it glowed blue and red.

“How are we supposed to take care of such a big heart?”

The skeletal Division Leader’s expression was weird.

Zhao Feng was silent for a while before he decided to use the old method.

Freeze!

Zhao Feng waved his hand and a cold lotus-shaped light spread over the heart.

However, the heart of the whale was extremely large and couldn’t be fully frozen right away.

“This is enough.”

Zhao Feng nodded his head. Half-frozen was enough. In fact, if it was fully frozen then the whale would die, which wasn’t good for the current situation.

“Hmm?”

The elder outside attacking sensed something.

The resistance from the whale suddenly became much smaller.

“Captain, what should we do?”

Loulan Zhishui and company didn’t understand.

Currently, the heart of the whale had been half-frozen, and the shaking of its body was weaker.

Zhao Feng said one word emotionlessly, “Dig.”

Miao miao!

As soon as he said that, the little thieving cat jumped out with a shovel.

Crack! Crack!

The little thieving cat pushed the shovel into the heart and started to dig.

Everyone’s eyes almost fell out.

The skeletal Division Leader was also shocked, but thinking about it carefully, this wasn’t exactly the first time Zhao Feng and the little thieving cat had done this.

“En. Everyone, get to work.”

Zhao Feng put one of his hands, which glowed with an ice lotus symbol, onto the heart.

As his bloodline became stronger, Zhao Feng comprehended how to use secret bloodline techniques that weren’t limited to just the Ice Imperial Spear. As his bloodline “traced back to its ancestor,” he managed to gleam some blurry information.

“Let’s do this.”

Everyone took out some tools or weapons and started to dig around the heart. The tougher sections were given to the little thieving cat.

Shu~~~~

The little thieving cat waved the mysterious dagger around and easily cut through the tough sections of the heart.

Around half the time it took to make tea later, the heart had been cut out of the whale.

Luckily, Zhao Feng had sealed the area in ice or else blood would have started flowing everywhere.

Take!

Zhao Feng raised his hand and put the enormous heart into his interspatial ring.

Luckily, this ring was provided to him by the Purple Saint Partial Spirit and was of a high rank, so it could fit the heart.

“What’s going on?”

The shirt-wearing elder outside found that something was wrong.

The whale in front of them had become extremely weak and lost the ability to fight back. Streams of blood surged out from its body, dying the ocean red.

Right at that moment:

Sou!

A small gray ship covered with ice shards shot out of the whale’s mouth.

“Who’s there!?”

The elder instinctively shouted, and the aura of a Great Origin Core Realm pressured the area.

The hearts of everyone on the ship jumped.

“Thank you for saving us, senior.”

Zhao Feng came out and gratefully bowed toward the elder.

Everyone within the ship couldn’t help but sweat coldly. It seemed like Zhao Feng was trying to bluff his way past a Great Origin Core Realm.

“You’re businessmen that were eaten by the whale?”

The elder thought about it and soon understood. It wasn’t the first time that a ship had been eaten by a limitless ocean whale.

As the two sides were talking:

Sou~ Sou Sou~~~

A large pirate ship with almost a hundred figures flew over. The head of the ship was in the shape of a triangle.

“The Metal Triangle Pirates are also here!?”

The elder couldn’t help but exclaim.

Three Origin Core Realm auras appeared from the ship, and the strongest one of them had reached the Great Origin Core Realm.

“Hahaha…. Surround them!”

An arrogant, sea-shaking laugh came from the ship.
